result.topic_en: Draft of an introductory passage on methodology: earlier treatments of functions started from particular analytic expressions and proved identities by transformation, whereas the author proposes starting from the determination of the function's 'Gestaltung' (its boundary and discontinuity conditions) and treating explicit expressions only as means of computing values.
